services.name: Manta Ray Night Snorkel
services.desc: Looking to snorkel with manta rays in Kona, Hawaii? This is the right tour for you! Come aboard with My Kona Adventures and chase the setting sun as we make our way toward our site for our Kona Manta Ray Night Snorkel excursion. We provide your snorkel gear, noodles/floats, and wetsuits are available to rent. After a quick boat ride to our destination, we get out in the water and project light down into the dark waters. The light attracts plankton which then attracts our manta rays for dinner time!
